description: 通过该接口获取备货单的平台收货仓地址信息（适用全托管、SHEIN自营模式）；

children.name: Content-Type
children.description: application/json;charset=UTF-8

children.name: x-lt-openKeyId
children.description: 访问用户隐私数据时的唯一权限标识 openKeyId

children.name: x-lt-timestamp
children.description: 请求时间戳，格式为时间转换为毫秒的值，也就是从1970年1月1日起至今的时间转换为毫秒，如：1583398764000

children.name: x-lt-signature
children.description: 接口签名

children.name: x-lt-language
children.description: 指定出参语种，默认中文；支持语种:英语:US 法语:FR 西班牙语:ES 德语:DE 中文简体:CN 泰语:TH 巴西葡语:PT 土耳其语：TR

children.name: addressId
children.description: 从发货基本信息查询接口获取；

children.name: coding
children.description: 车队编码

children.name: expressMode
children.description: 快递编码

children.name: orderType
children.description: 订单类型；1:急采；2：备货

children.name: sendType
children.description: 发货方式；从发货基本信息查询接口获取；

children.name: orderNoList
children.description: 采购单号；建议填写，会影响地址的准确性；最多入参200个；

children.name: shippingRoute
children.description: 发货路径： 1：直送 2：集货 默认值为1，直送

children.name: code
children.description: 响应编码 成功：0

children.name: subWareHouseId
children.description: 子仓id

children.name: subWarehouseName
children.description: 子仓名称

children.name: warehouseAddress
children.description: 收货仓详细地址

children.name: warehouseContact
children.description: 仓联系人

children.name: warehousePhone
children.description: 样衣仓联系电话

children.name: consolidationSubWareHouseId
children.description: 集货仓子仓id，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationSubWarehouseName
children.description: 集货仓子仓名称，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehouseAddress
children.description: 集货仓收件详细地址，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehouseCityArea
children.description: 集货仓收件区，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehouseCityName
children.description: 集货仓收件城市，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehouseContact
children.description: 集货仓仓联系人，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehousePhone
children.description: 集货仓仓联系方式，仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: consolidationWarehouseProvinceName
children.description: 集货仓收件省（直辖市），仅发货路径为集货时有值

children.name: msg
children.description: 错误描述,成功：OK；（全托管模式支持指定语种出参）；

children.name: traceId
children.description: 请求的唯一标识；用于异常报错跟踪

responseExample: code": "0", "msg": "OK", "info": { "subWareHouseId": 4, "subWarehouseName": "佛山佳明仓", "warehouseAddress": "广东 深圳市 大鹏 12345", "warehouseContact": "佳明仓", "warehousePhone": "15222222222" }, "bbl": null }
